Urdu Poetry 💙

In English we say "I love you"
But in Urdu we say

"Agar hona chahu tera
Tum hone doge kya,

Rona chahu tere pass aake
Tum rone doge kya,

Chain nahi mil raha ab mujhe kahi pe
Tum apne dil mein chain se rehne doge kya"
